verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents Teams Export APIs that export 1:1, group, meeting, and channel messages, including user-deleted messages for up to 21 days, so message data can be pulled out programmatically. The evidence does not show a self-service 'export everything' path, does not state that the output is in open formats, and does not cover files, meetings, or other content needed for a complete exit. Missing for 10: documented open/standard export format, coverage of files and non-message data, end-user self-service full-account export, independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete migration-out workflow.
